text: Good morning, chef! Tap our customer to hear their order. Tap the little speaker whenever you want to hear me again.
Follow the sparkly path with your finger. Start at the green dot. Then tap the tick. Tap the curled arrow to start again.
Let’s follow the whole path together. Try the glowing guide.
Tap the food to put it in the basket. Tap the basket when you have enough.
Each coin is worth one. Tap coins to pay, then tap the till.
Drag each ingredient into the pan. Then tap the spoon to stir.
Thank you, chef! A sparkle for your café!
The café is closing soon. Let’s finish our last customer.
Our café is closed. Thank you, chef! See you next time.
Count the food with me. You can tap the basket food to put one back.
One coin for each item. You can tap a paid coin to take one back.
Watch me, then you can finish.
Tap the spoon three times, then bring the plate to our customer.
Tap the sparkle to visit the café.
Our café looks lovely! Tap a decoration to make it sparkle while we wait for closing time.
Let’s write the order ticket. Tap the pencil.
Your turn. Finish the last path, then tap the tick.
Add one more, then tap the basket.
Pay one more coin, then tap the tick.
Drag the food into the pan.
Drag the food into the pan first.
Delicious! Tap the plate to serve.
Tap the plate to give our customer their food.
Sparkle, sparkle! Thank you for caring for our café.
Buddy is having a little nap.
Buddy says woof woof, great job!
Tap a food to open it.
Tap the sun for a new day!
Tap each dot to hear the sounds.
Look, then copy it on your pad.
Listen to the unicorn, then play it back!
Tap the lid with the music!
High or low? Tap the one you heard!
Play the notes on the card!
Play anything on the black keys!
A surprise! A sticker for your book!
Your dish goes on the café shelf!
Your sticker book! Tap the curled arrow to visit the café.
You started at the green dot and followed the whole path!
You listened and played it back!
You said each sound and blended the word!
You kept trying until you got it!
You looked carefully and wrote it yourself!
You listened and found the rhyme!
You heard it and found it!
How many are hiding in the bag?
Ten and some more. How many?
Play the key that lights up!
Trace the word to put it in the pot!
A new recipe for your book!
